name: Natovenator
sum: Halszkaraptorine from the Barun Goyot Formation of Mongolia with a streamlined body that supports a semiaquatic lifestyle.
holotype: A mostly articulated skeleton with a nearly complete skull, Barun Goyot Formation, Hermiin Tsav, Mongolia (Lee et al. 2022).
biology: Provides more support for a semi-aquatic lifestyle in halszkaraptorines.
author: Lee et al. 2022
